description.text: One single attack (8.00) capped at 99,999, ranged. Grants [Buster Mode], [Buster Chase Mode: Ward], [Instant ATB 1] to user. Grants [Attach Water with Secondary Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Secondary Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Secondary Stacking].

description.name: Buster Mode
description.text: Enables Buster Soul Break's Break Arte

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Water with Secondary Stacking

description.name: Attach Ice with Secondary Stacking

description.name: Attach Earth with Secondary Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 5, up to Attach Earth 5
